output.brief: The Kestria buffering is almost certainly caused by the new smart-TV app 5.2, not by the CDN switch. Kestria was the only market chosen for the 5.2 rollout, which reached 100% there on 9 Oct, the same day as the CDN cutover. That app version cut the startup buffer from 10 s to 4 s. Smart-TV 5.2 rebuffers at 5.9% on every ISP. Every other client on the same Tessaline CDN and the same ISPs stays at 0.6–0.7%. Employee TVs served by Corvane showed the same fault (5.7% vs 0.6%) before launch, and a ticket to fix it was deferred. The handball launch did not move the rate on match nights. ISP congestion doesn't fit either. Cancellations may be partly due to buffering, but the 1 Oct price rise is a competing explanation, so that link is unproven. Next steps: 1) Revert Kestria to the old streaming settings (abr_v2 remote config, about an hour, no new build). 2) Hold the 20 Nov wider rollout until it's fixed. 3) Don't send the breach notice, withhold fees or move traffic back. 4) Don't mute the alert. 5) Add app version and device breakdowns to the dashboard. 6) Hold off on any win-back offer until you've checked the exit-survey reasons.
